problems.stem: Which task fits best in 'tasks I will use AI for'?
options: Writing my reflection on my own experience.
Getting feedback on the clarity of a paragraph I wrote.
problems.explanation: Feedback on your own writing is support work you can check.

problems.stem: What is the most reliable way to check an AI-provided fact?
options: Find the original source and confirm it says the same thing.
Check whether the answer is long.
Ask a friend if it sounds right.
problems.explanation: Independent, original sources are the standard for checking facts.

problems.stem: Why revisit your AI use plan after each major assignment?
options: Tools, policies and your own needs change.
It is required by every AI tool.
problems.explanation: Reflection keeps the plan useful as conditions change.
